findings.title: Bind routines responses to their initiating item
findings.why_it_matters: Switching to another mechanism while AI generation is pending saves the first mechanism's response into the second mechanism. The selector remains enabled and changes the shared I variable; options, initial generation, and revision all write through that variable after awaiting the provider. Initial generation additionally clears the other mechanism's people, runs, decisions, and version history. Capturing the initiating item and checking its continued existence and revision before applying results prevents cross-item corruption while allowing navigation.

findings.suggested_fix: For options, build, and revise, capture a target item plus an immutable request-context/revision identifier before await. Apply the response only to that still-existing, unchanged target, and render or move steps only if it remains the selected item. Invalidate pending operations on deletion or replacement and prevent duplicate generation for the same revision. Add deferred-provider VM tests covering switch, deletion, and a second operation.

findings.title: Isolate new demo tools from personal workspaces
findings.why_it_matters: Running the new routines or family bridge demonstration overwrites the administrator's ordinary saved workspace. These interfaces load and save the same owner key in demo mode, and the recipes invoke example followed by generation; example already replaces and persists the private form, while successful generation resets the plan and its associated tracking data. The demo's capture input can also include other restored private fields. The existing gated in-memory storage pattern in participation and continuity prevents both persistence damage and private input entering demo artifacts.

findings.title: Keep practice demos away from saved personal cases
findings.why_it_matters: The ordinary practice demonstration now automatically selects a saved personal case when one exists, rather than a catalogue example. The newly added myCases area appears before the catalogue and renders the same scenario-card class, so the unscoped first-card query selects private case content. The recipe sends that selected character context through the AI conversation and returns its title, transcript, and feedback as a demo artifact. The new own-case demonstration also writes its generated case and clears the private draft through ordinary storage, so both recipes need a fresh demo workspace.
